meta.description:
Checks that the hashes of the SBOM's top level components identify
the cryptographic algorithm that produced them. This implements
the _Component Hash Algorithm_ element of the CISA 2026 SBOM
Minimum Elements.

Protobom normalizes hash algorithm names when ingesting the SBOM,
so the check requires every hash entry to be keyed by a recognized
algorithm.
meta.name: Component Hash Algorithm

error.message: One or more top level components have no hash keyed by a recognized cryptographic algorithm
error.guidance: Identify the hash algorithm of each component checksum using standard algorithm names (for example SHA256)

assessment.message: All top level component hashes identify their algorithm
